title: 22nd sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/22/2024).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 16/2024 to 18/2024).
From the Speaker's desk: election of members, under Rule 150 of the Majlis Standing Orders, to the newly created Housing Committee (a standing committee set up under Rule 115).
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the Local Council Elections Act (Law No. 10/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Kaashidhoo MP Muntazim Ibrahim.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Bill amending the Employment Act (Law No. 2/2008), submitted on behalf of the government by Kulhudhuffushi North MP Mohamed Dawood.
Report of the Human Rights and Gender Committee on its review of the President's nomination of a member to the Human Rights Commission of the Maldives.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting elected members to the new Housing Committee, debated the local council elections amendment, continued the Employment Act debate and reviewed a Human Rights Commission nomination.
